## Agent — weekly email drafts

Every Monday 07:30 UTC (10:30 Riyadh), after the research run at 06:00, the agent container writes three marketing-email options for the week into `email_ai_drafts`. The Marketing tab shows them.

Handler: `server/agentHandlers/emailWeekly.js` (Claude Sonnet, job `email_weekly`). What the model is given, and why: `src/lib/email/weekly.js`.

**Never add retryOnFail to the HTTP node**: it is a paid call, and n8n retries re-send it.

Webhook `/arak-email-weekly`: the app's "Write this week's drafts" button, through the signed Vercel proxy. The caller's token is forwarded; the agent checks membership.

nodes.name: POST /api/agent/emailWeekly
nodes.notes: A paid Sonnet call. No retryOnFail on purpose: a retry re-sends it. A second call in the same week answers 'already written' or 409 and spends nothing.
